# Host runtime entry points

<!-- Generated by scripts/core_docs.py; edit the source of truth and regenerate. -->

The host discovers directly decorated strategies, injects chart data, context, and instrument details, and executes them. Discovery requires no market data.

[Usage guide](../guides/runtime.md) · [Compatibility and internal entries](classification.md)

<a id="openbacktesting-runtime-describe"></a>

## describe

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.runtime.describe`

```python
openbacktesting.runtime.describe(namespace: collections.abc.Mapping) -> dict
```

Export inputs and complete default backtest settings without market data or executing the strategy lifecycle.

The returned backtest description is independent of input schemaHash; modifying copies does not alter class declarations.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/runtime.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-runtime-run"></a>

## run

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.runtime.run`

```python
openbacktesting.runtime.run(namespace: collections.abc.Mapping, request: collections.abc.Mapping | None = None, *, data: pandas.DataFrame, context: openbacktesting.data.context.DataContext, instrument: openbacktesting.broker.instrument.InstrumentSpec, settings: collections.abc.Mapping | None = None, options: collections.abc.Mapping | None = None, logs: openbacktesting.logs.RunLogs | None = None) -> pandas.Series
```

Run a new session for this chart and return existing results plus backtest_snapshot.

Args:
    namespace: Module successfully loaded by the host for this run; bt-only exports are no longer accepted.
    request: Existing title-based input request; None uses defaults.
    data: Current chart OHLC with a timezone-aware DatetimeIndex.
    context: Actual timeframe and shared timezone for charts, strategy calendars, and statistics.
        Convert the internal index before strategy construction, preserving inputs and absolute instants without resampling.
        Changing timezone requires a new run; local-time conditions and statistics grouped by day may change.
    instrument: Chart instrument specifications, without inference from market data.
    settings: Sparse overrides of flat settings; enum fields accept corresponding members or exact strings.
        Changing types requires supplying a value too; default_qty_value=None clears the default quantity.
    options: cache budget, plotting, and plotting_limits are host runtime options.
    logs: Optional host log session; get_logs works after success or exceptions, and sequential reuse clears old records.

No source loading, cached old instances, or declaration changes; exceptions propagate unchanged.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/runtime.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-datacontext"></a>

## DataContext

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.DataContext`

```python
openbacktesting.DataContext(timeframe: openbacktesting.data.timeframe.Timeframe, timezone: str) -> None
```

Describe the existing market-data timeframe and shared timezone for charts, strategy calendars, and statistics.

Timezone-aware market data is converted to this timezone before strategy construction; absolute instants and original data remain unchanged.
Statistics group by local day boundaries; changing timezone requires a new run, and annualized metrics may differ.
Provides no downloading, resampling, or exchange-calendar capability.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/data/context.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-runtime-discover"></a>

## discover

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.runtime.discover`

```python
openbacktesting.runtime.discover(namespace: collections.abc.Mapping) -> type[openbacktesting.engine.Strategy]
```

Discover the single concrete strategy directly decorated in this module; deduplicate aliases and exclude imported and inherited entry points.

Args:
    namespace: Successfully loaded module namespace containing a nonempty string __name__.

Returns:
    type[Strategy]: Original strategy class, without instance construction.

Raises:
    TypeError: Invalid namespace or declaration.
    ValueError: No entry point or multiple entry points.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/runtime.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-runlogs"></a>

## RunLogs

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.RunLogs`

```python
openbacktesting.RunLogs()
```

Host-owned single-run log session, injected through runtime.run(..., logs=session).

Sequential reuse clears records before strategy discovery; a session cannot serve concurrent runs.
Queryable after success or exceptional exit; returns list and dictionary copies without holding author stack frames.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/logs.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-runlogs-get-logs"></a>

### get_logs

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.RunLogs.get_logs`

```python
openbacktesting.RunLogs.get_logs(self) -> list[dict[str, str | int | None]]
```

Return an independent copy of all logs from this run; an empty list before the first run.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/logs.py`。

<a id="openbacktesting-runtime-optimize"></a>

## optimize

Qualified object: `openbacktesting.runtime.optimize`

```python
openbacktesting.runtime.optimize(namespace: collections.abc.Mapping, search: collections.abc.Mapping, *, path, identity, data: pandas.DataFrame, context: openbacktesting.data.context.DataContext, instrument: openbacktesting.broker.instrument.InstrumentSpec, request=None, settings=None, constraint=None, constraint_id=None, cancel=None, on_progress=None) -> openbacktesting.optimizer.query.ExperimentResult
```

Exhaustively search selected inputs sequentially, committing each complete Portfolio to a new local result database.

Unselected values come from the current request; retain only Portfolio without collecting logs/plotting.
identity is a host-supplied ExecutionIdentity; the framework computes data/configuration identities.
constraint uses complete wire values and requires constraint_id; cancel is a no-argument callable.
Return a read-only ExperimentResult; record strategy-trial failures and continue, but stop on storage failures.

Source: `src/openbacktesting/runtime.py`。
